error_reason: In Turn 14, the Planner incorrectly analyzed the content of the America East Conference Wikipedia page. It stated that the history section lists 'Formerly Eastern College Athletic Conference-North (1988–1996)' and 'North Atlantic Conference (1979–1988)'.
